items.question: How much does a biodigester cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on volume and site. After a technical visit, we provide a detailed quote matched to your livestock and budget.

items.question: How long does construction take?
items.answer: Typically 3–6 weeks from excavation to commissioning, depending on project size.

items.question: Is Agri-Shell suited to all crops?
items.answer: Yes. Dosage is adjusted by crop type — market garden, cereals, or orchard. Our team guides you through the protocol.

items.question: Do you offer maintenance after installation?
items.answer: Yes, technical follow-up is offered after commissioning, along with user training.

items.question: Do you work with NGOs and institutions?
items.answer: Yes, we build partnerships with rural development stakeholders.
